title: Cold rebuild: make CI green
summary: Fix a pull request's formatting, validate and tflint failures properly, from memory.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: In *Plan on the pull request, apply on merge* you made `make ci` pass on a red pull request without silencing any
rule. Do it again from memory: **no hints, no solution**, the same checks.

steps.title: Make CI green, cold
prompt: In `~/infra/shop-repo`, make `make ci` (fmt, validate, tflint) pass by fixing the code: no `tflint-ignore`, no changes
to `.tflint.hcl` or the `Makefile`. `retention_days` stays, typed, and ends up in the rendered JSON. Commit.
From memory: no hints this time.
